'''''Mauranthemum paludosum''''' (formerly '''''Chrysanthemum paludosum''''' and '''''Leucanthemum paludosum'''''), commonly known as '''creeping daisy''' or '''mini marguerite''', is a [[perennial plant]] of the family [[Asteraceae]].

==Description==
A [[perennial plant|perennial]], the plant height is about 15 cm to 25 cm. It is a [[Dwarfing|dwarf]] and is an [[ornamental plant]]. Also grown as a cool season [[annual plant]], the flower's [[inflorescence]]s are small [[flower head]]s with white [[ligule]]s arranged around the yellow centre. Its green leaves are coarse, leathery and rather greyish {{convert|5|in|mm|round=5|order=flip|abbr=on}} long or shorter. The flowers open when the sun shines on them.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mygardenlife.com/plant-library/4243/chrysanthemum/paludosum|title = Creeping Daisy, Mini Marguerite (Chrysanthemum paludosum) | My Garden Life}}</ref>

==Distribution==
''Mauranthemum paludosum'' is native to the western Mediterranean, including [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]], and [[Tunisia]], eastern and southern [[Spain]], and the [[Balearic Islands]].<ref name = powo/> It is widely distributed along the [[Mediterranean coast]].

==Subspecies==
Two subspecies are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Mauranthemum paludosum'' subsp. ''ebusitanum'' {{small|(Vogt) Vogt & Oberpr.}} – Balearic Islands
*''Mauranthemum paludosum'' subsp. ''paludosum'' – eastern and southern Spain, Algeria, Morocco, and Tunisia

==Cultivation==
Tolerant of many soils and requiring full sun, it is usually planted in [[rock garden]]s and border fronts, and can be ideal for all sorts of containers.<ref>[https://www.backyardgardener.com/plantname/leucanthemum-paludosum-paludosum-daisy/ Leucanthemum Paludosum ( Paludosum Daisy )]</ref>
